newsitem.title: UK: Seven-year gilts still sought on UK gilt repo mkt.
newsitem.headline: Seven-year gilts still sought on UK gilt repo mkt.

text.p: The 8.0 percent gilts due 2003 continued to attract good demand on the UK gilt repo market, but at between 3.0 and 3.75 percent, they were less special than on Friday, when overnight quotes went to 1.5 percent.
* Overnight general collateral peaked around 6.25 percent
* Interest seen in 7.0 percent gilts due 2001, two weeks around 5.25 percent, one month 5.20 10
* Interest also reported in 6.0 percent gilts due 1999 in one month
* Overnight cash firmed to close at 6-3/8 percent, top of day's range. Day's low was around 5-5/8
* Shortage 800 million stg, Bank of England assistance totalled 659 million.

* Consensus is no that no change in official interest rates will follow today's UK monetary meeting, which lasted around 50 minutes. Any change would probably be signalled in Bank of England money market operations on Tuesday morning. Markets also await Tuesday's FOMC meeting.
